text:
ashley.ng: Heads-up: we're shifting the EU-region KV-router maintenance window from Tue 04:30 UTC previously planned to Tue 04:30–05:15 UTC (moved ~90m later) due to datacenter network ops. Expected impact: brief (<5m) control-plane rotation + degraded KV prefetch for up to 15m. We'll post to status.redwood.com and send a customer notice. @oncall-rotation please ack; incident-bot please schedule a pager 30m before the window.

incident-bot: Scheduled maintenance recorded: id=mn-202603-174. Pager will be created 30m before window and reminder posted 60m prior.

kevin.s: ack. Quick q: can we shorten the window to 40m? customers react to long windows.

ashley.ng: Trying to — netops fixed one constraint but need the extra buffer for canary + rollout. Operational mitigation: canary first (2 nodes) for 10m, monitor latency and 5xxs; continue rollout if stable. Rollback criteria: error rate >2% sustained over 2m or KV-prefetch timeouts >1% of requests.

maria_g: I'll handle external comms. Can we explicitly state 'no customer data deletion' and an estimate of affected customers (even if small)? saves support a lot of tickets.

ashley.ng: Draft status page copy below — please review: 

```Scheduled maintenance: Tue 04:30–05:15 UTC (EU region). We expect a brief control-plane rotation and short KV-prefetch degradation for up to 15 minutes during the window. Impact: short-lived elevated latency and transient 429/503 responses at low rates. No data loss. Embeddings indexing may be slower briefly after the window while caches warm.```

Customer email snippet (to send from support): 

```Hello — We are performing scheduled maintenance in our EU region on Tue 04:30–05:15 UTC. During the window you may experience briefly elevated latency and transient errors for up to ~15 minutes. This maintenance will not result in any data deletion. Embeddings/indexing may perform slower for a short warm-up period after the window. If you see persistent issues after the window, please contact support@redwood.ai.```

kevin.s: I'll take oncall for the window and run the pager test 1h before. @maria_g can you give final approval for the external copy? :+1:

maria_g: Approved. Tiny wording tweak: change 'transient errors' -> 'transient 429/503 responses' for clarity. Also add contact link to status page.

ashley.ng: Updated copy with 429/503 and status link. Finalizing status update — will publish 60m before start and post completion notice once all canaries pass. Thanks all :rocket:
